classification_definitions.internal_engineering: Must be designed, implemented, tested, and packaged by Blind Ledger; outside help is not a closure dependency.
classification_definitions.security_audit_gate: The one independent assurance gate after all internal engineering packages close.
classification_definitions.activation_input: A live credential, endpoint, signer, account, or authorization supplied to the finished release; not missing engineering.

blockers.title: Production native STARK prover and verifier
blockers.current_evidence: A real Rust selected-AIR proof can be generated and independently replayed by the native verifier executable; the exact executable plus AIR program bytes are SHA3-512-domain-separated into the enforced artifact identity, the version-2 proof package is an exact 64 MiB container, and its authenticated transcript is independently checked. Independent composition review established that this is a narrow selected-AIR component, not the complete Wave1A semantic-bus, typed-state, H4 claim/payment/replay/state theorem. Aggregate qualification is fail closed and no current path reaches BUILT_AUDIT_PENDING.
blockers.remaining_work: Implement and independently verify a verifier-safe H4 proof grammar, the complete semantic-bus trace producer and proof-native M31/Fp16 equality, a verifier-safe typed-state component, and then one fixed-shape version-3 composite grammar and standalone verifier. Close the selected suite, parser, supply-chain, reproducible release, and exact production-verifier qualification gaps without treating version-2 component evidence as the complete theorem.
blockers.exit_criteria: The complete native STARK prover and independent verifier lane is internally implemented, reproducible, pinned, and qualified for the exact statement, suite, sidecar, and public-input schema, with a per-proof candidate identity in BUILT_AUDIT_PENDING; the global operational proofSuiteId remains unset until deployed acceptance and audit.

blockers.title: Final independent Security Audit Gate
blockers.exit_criteria: One independent audit covers AIR soundness, witness hiding/PQ, wide-state cryptography, native verification, atomic database transitions, supply chain, and privacy/side-channel/operations; all critical and high findings are closed or formally accepted for the exact release identities.

blockers.title: Exact claim-proof output and database-transition binding
blockers.current_evidence: The exact 12-field projection and full sidecar pass through the real Rust candidate verifier into a serializable SQLite reference. The executable-plus-program identity and a per-store keyed verifier-to-storage authorization channel are enforced. The state and audit bind the authenticated submitter without exposing its raw identifier in audit output. Focused tests cover atomic nullifier/payment/state/audit publication, concurrency, exact and conflicting retry, stale roots, duplicate nullifier roots, pre-commit anchor reservation replay, post-commit anchor-finalization recovery without double advance, delayed finalization after a later transition, pending-operation tampering, rollback detection, restart, backup/restore, audit tampering, and configuration drift.
blockers.remaining_work: The LB-006 internal exit criteria are met only for local, synthetic, nonactivating evidence. Production database selection/qualification, durable custody, final proof-suite selection, independent audit, real PHI/payments, and activation remain governed by other open packages and blockers.
blockers.exit_criteria: One real verifier authenticates the exact versioned 12-field output and full sidecar consumed by the atomic database transition; length, order, encoding, proof format, suite, schema, and verifier identities are reproducibly pinned, and no caller-supplied unproven value can advance state.

blockers.title: Privacy V2 proof and state migration
blockers.current_evidence: The ordered public ABI remains exactly twelve fields. The local schema-v2 SQLite path atomically migrates profile, suite-candidate, schema, verifier, epoch/domain, roots, state binding, immutable history, and audit after pinned native verification. Fresh evidence requires bounded OS randomness and a private freshness seal; exact durable retry survives a new Python process; old-profile races, conflicting retries, reused rollback/recovery domains, anti-rollback failures, and partial writes fail closed. Two real dual-PQ Rust proofs from different private witnesses independently verified with identical public/proof/transcript/envelope shapes; one migration committed and the conflicting second was rejected without another sequence advance. Public artifacts exclude tested amount, decision, PHI, claim, and replacement literals.
blockers.remaining_work: The LB-007 exit criteria are met only for local, synthetic, nonactivating Phase 2 evidence. Production proof composition, database and durable anti-rollback selection, entropy/custody operations, independent audit, real PHI/payments, and activation remain governed by other open packages and blockers.
blockers.exit_criteria: The parallel V2 proof and settlement path removes exact amounts, counts, decisions, PHI, and claim ciphertext from public data; differential, inference, known-answer, attack, migration, and rollback tests pass.

blockers.title: Provider-neutral PQ KMS/HSM and private-data operations
blockers.current_evidence: Provider-neutral interfaces and software-only references cover PQ key use, rotation, audit chaining, recovery anchors, incident control, and destructive key-state transitions in local tests.
blockers.remaining_work: Qualify isolated deployment, authorization, retention, legal hold, backup/restore, crash recovery, verifiable crypto-erasure, provider conformance, and external anti-rollback without claiming HSM or FIPS validation.
blockers.exit_criteria: Provider-neutral KMS/HSM ports, software/reference implementations, conformance tests, isolated worker deployment, authorization, audit, rotation, retention, legal-hold, backup, crash-recovery, destruction, and crypto-erasure controls are implemented and pass local/sandbox qualification.

blockers.title: Zero-knowledge witness-hiding proof backend
blockers.current_evidence: The active Construction-8.2 GKR hiding candidate and bounded simulator records remain nonactivating component evidence. Both selected worker binaries now own fresh OS entropy and zeroize mask/attempt state, and the fixed 64 MiB version-2 package closes one observable-size defect. Independent review found that H4 receipts retain child-output digests rather than a verifier-safe proof, typed state lacks a public replayable transcript and exposes execution material, and the aggregate receipt was self-attestable. The caller-paired receipt/digest path is removed and aggregate status remains AGGREGATE_UNQUALIFIED.
blockers.remaining_work: Close Z03-Z12 with raw machine-derived evidence: complete exposure inventories, proof-level masking and entropy qualification, durable transcript custody, a closed strict-PQ union ledger, real abort/retry/crash behavior, and actual parser fuzz/unlinkability campaigns. Compose those results only after the verifier-safe H4, semantic-bus equality, typed-state, and version-3 standalone verifier prerequisites exist.
blockers.exit_criteria: The complete claim backend internally implements and qualifies native zero-knowledge witness hiding; leakage tests cover proof and metadata artifacts; the exact suite reaches BUILT_AUDIT_PENDING.

blockers.title: Human governance signer enrollment
blockers.exit_criteria: Authorized operators supply multisig signers and run the shipped enrollment, recovery, timelock, audit, and rollback procedures against the audited release.

blockers.title: Live government and oracle endpoint activation
blockers.exit_criteria: Authorized operators supply official endpoint versions, credentials, source identities, signing keys, epochs, and governed roots to adapters that already passed I01-I08 local/sandbox conformance.

blockers.title: Payment and jurisdictional authorization
blockers.exit_criteria: Authorized operators supply the approved pilot jurisdiction, payment accounts, limits, and legal/compliance authorization to the audited release without changing product code.
